proof.text: The statement already uses sheaves valued in ModuleCat Λ, as do the fixed canonical comparisons. The instances moduleAbelianForget_preservesFiniteLimits and moduleAbelianForget_preservesFiniteColimits give exactness directly. For every scheme T and degree i, take the inverse of Functor.mapDerivedCategoryPlusHomologyFunctorIso to obtain the stated cohomology comparison. No separate change of sheaf encoding is necessary in this proof.

The canonical inverse-image comparisons on all four edges and derived direct-image comparisons on f and f′ are isomorphisms by their existing instances. Apply moduleAbelianDerivedExchange_compatibility to sq.toCommSq and K. Its equation uses exactly the source and target isomorphisms in the statement.

Since the endpoint comparisons are isomorphisms, isIso_comp_right_iff and isIso_comp_left_iff applied to the compatibility equation identify invertibility of the forgotten module exchange with invertibility of the abelian exchange. The forward implication of the final equivalence follows because every functor preserves isomorphisms.

For the converse, the preceding equivalence gives invertibility of the forgotten module exchange. Apply each abelian homology functor. NatIso.isIso_map_iff for moduleAbelianForget.mapDerivedCategoryPlusHomologyFunctorIso transfers this to invertibility of the underlying abelian map of each module cohomology map. The standard sheafCompose reflection instance, induced by reflection for forget₂ (ModuleCat Λ) AddCommGrpCat, then gives invertibility of every module cohomology map. By DerivedCategory.Plus.isIso_iff the module exchange itself is invertible.
